title: Document the shared source_basis wire in acceptance reads and keep an oversized source_id from hiding later candidates
outcome: Document the shared source_basis wire in acceptance reads and keep an oversized source_id from hiding later candidates
acceptance: The acceptance-evaluation and execution-observability docs state the exact shared source_basis wire (full VerificationSourceBasis object, no source_revision) returned by the host-private acceptance_binding_read / acceptance_verification_read rows, and the visible oversize refusal

Before shared evaluation is activated, an oversized shared candidate cannot permanently hide later candidates of the same criterion behind page_too_large; the whole source_id object is kept, with no digest surrogate, and historical rows are unchanged
A test covers a criterion with an oversized shared candidate followed by a normal-sized one
